name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks quickstart end-to-end. Installed the OpenAI Python SDK (already present), created the quickstart script using the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and received a chat completion response "¡Hola!" from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API.
deviations: The quickstart documentation specifies model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, but that model returned a 404 NotFoundError ("Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed"). I queried the available models endpoint and substituted `accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2` — an available chat-capable model — to achieve a successful chat completion. All other steps (SDK installation, base_url, API key usage, request format) followed the docs exactly.
